data.body:
Reproduction (before the fix), 2026-10-31, macOS host, Python 3.12.14, worktree at 66be683cc7c. Method: a scratch pytest plugin wraps one function inside each test's timed window and, when it is called, a helper sends SIGSTOP to the whole test process and SIGCONT after N seconds (models a descheduled CI worker). Without the plugin the 3 tests pass (3 passed in 3.79s).
- test_doctor_mapping: freeze 4.5 s at entry to doctor_mapping._run_bounded -> 3 of 3 failed: "AssertionError: doctor must not block on a hanging probe" (elapsed >= 4.0). Note: a freeze inside the probe worker thread did not land inside the window reliably (helper spawn outlasted the 0.2 s join), so the entry point is used.
- test_review_bot lifespan: freeze 2.5 s, scheduled 0.1 s after shutdown_cancel_seconds() is called (inside the 0.3 s cancel window) -> 3 of 3 failed: "review-bot shutdown took 2.74s / 2.75s / 2.85s".
- test_gate_admission_09da refusal: freeze 5.5 s inside the 2nd _acquire_slot call (the refused admission) -> 3 of 3 failed: "admission blocked for 5.58s / 5.55s / 5.56s instead of fast-failing".
Observation for the gate test: removing LOCK_NB (the real defect) makes the same-process second flock block forever, so the 5 s ceiling never evaluates; only pytest-timeout (300 s) would end it. The ceiling therefore catches stalls, not the queueing defect.
